# MacroDroid collection

Source: https://github.com/BespredeL/MacroDroid
Revision: 46bd349236f20879d2a68fa9cd57ad0c8a98de7c
License: MIT; LICENSE retained here and in APK assets/licenses.

Eleven template copies are retained in app/src/main/assets/macros. For public distribution, four capability-style webhook URLs in three templates were replaced with inert example.invalid placeholders. JSON structure, other template content and the MIT notice are retained. The pinned upstream revision identifies the original source.
This is a macro collection, not the MacroDroid app's source or runtime.
Import preserves source JSON and reports unsupported semantics; source macros
are never enabled or flattened into approximate executable actions. Native
manual media-volume and flashlight recipes are explicitly labeled adaptations.

Publication adaptation: nineteen private IPv4 address occurrences in IntruderCam, Remote_Filemanager and Wake_PC were replaced with the documentation address `192.0.2.1`. Configure your own network targets before use. Remote file-management templates are source examples, are imported paused, and are not executed by publication.
